description: S7 evaluation set for the mock desk sequence (scripts/make_demo_sequence.py), asked on the scene graph after the last frame. expect_target: label of the object the verifier must return, or null when the system must refuse ('Cannot determine'). expect_validated: whether S6 must accept the path. llm_claim: what an unverified LLM answered when asked the same question directly; when it is wrong the verifier must override it (hallucination catch rate).
